method: Within-lender demeaned association between log(annual FHA volume) and observed denial rate, 2018-2025, pooled across lenders. Permutation test shuffles years within each lender.
boundaries: Descriptive association, not a capacity model and not causal.
Volume and denial rate are jointly determined by rate cycles, product mix and strategy.
Per-lender estimates are not reported: seven annual observations per lender cannot support them.
